interpretation: The intervention has real but heterogeneous causal effects in this fixed system. Two boundary episodes improve and two worsen; do not call it universally irrelevant.

The mean return deficits persist when elite-dispersion updating is removed. These results do not support the claim that this update is necessary for the existing harm or a reliable recovery mechanism.
Fixed dispersion does not remove mean-dependent boundary clipping, model error, normalization differences, data coverage differences or all possible candidate covariance changes.

A positive mean interaction is not sufficient evidence of a special boundary-data mechanism: random and interior controls each began with3/4 ceiling episodes, and there are only four reused development roots.

The selected complete sequence also supplies the next-query warm start. A changed unexecuted tail can precede later decision differences even if the immediate first action is equal; this is not a new attack result.
No attack success rate, confidence interval or significance claim is inferred from dependent planner queries or24 paired conditions.
